question: Which of the following committees/commissions was set up in 1976 for recommending for fundamental duties by the Indira Gandhi Government ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swaran Singh Committee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Swaran Singh Committee was set up in **1976** by the Indira Gandhi Government.
 
• The committee was tasked with the responsibility of **recommending fundamental duties** that should be included in the Indian Constitution.
 
• This committee's recommendations led to the incorporation of **Part IV-A** and the addition of **Article 51A** in the Indian Constitution.
 
• Article 51A lays down a code of **11 fundamental duties** for Indian citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thakaar Commission**

 
 
• The Thakaar Commission was constituted to look into the **affairs of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes** in India.
 
• It aimed at addressing grievances and ensuring the rights of these communities are safeguarded.
 
 
 
• **Sarkaria Commission**
 
 
• The Sarkaria Commission, constituted in 1983, was tasked with examining the **relationship and balance of power between state and central governments** in India.
 
• Its focus was on improving coordination and cooperation between the states and the center.
 
 
 
• **Shah Commission**
 
 
• The Shah Commission was established in 1977 to investigate **excesses committed during the Emergency** period in India (1975-1977).
 
• It examined various abuses of power, including arbitrary detentions and human rights violations.
